title: Density Collapse and Gradient Catastrophe in a One-Dimensional Euler--Poisson--Cattaneo System
summary: We study finite-time singularity formation for a one-dimensional Euler--Poisson system in Lagrangian coordinates with Cattaneo heat conduction and quadratic heat-flux corrections in the pressure and internal energy. Under the structural choice $κ=κ_0v$, two different breakdown mechanisms are obtained. First, an explicit affine solution reaches $v=0$ in finite time, so the Eulerian density $ρ=1/v$ diverges while the remaining state variables stay finite at each fixed spatial point.
